IRS990.MissionDesc: THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO SUPPORTS AND EMPOWERS PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES TO ACHIEVE THEIR LIFE GOALS.
IRS990.Desc: EMPLOYMENT SERVICES: THIS PROGRAM IS AN OPPORTUNITY TO LEARN A VARIETY OF SKILLS THAT WILL PREPARE PARTICIPANTS FOR THE TYPE OF WORK THEY WANT. THEY GAIN VALUABLE EXPERIENCE WORKING ON A VARIETY OF LIGHT INDUSTRIAL CONTRACTS, JANITORIAL, GROUNDS MAINTENANCE, FOOD SERVICES, AND RECYCLING JOBS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: ADULT DAY SERVICES: THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO'S DAY TRAINING PROGRAMS COMBINE CLASSROOM INSTRUCTION WITH COMMUNITY INTEGRATION AND VOCATIONAL DEVELOPMENT. FAMILIES, SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CENTER SOCIAL WORKERS, AND THE ARC STAFF HELP DEVELOP GOALS AND OBJECTIVES THAT LEAD TO A BETTER FUTURE. THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO PAYS SPECIAL ATTENTION TO PERSONAL NEEDS AND PREFERENCES. EVERY WEEK, A SCHEDULE STRUCTURED AROUND INTEREST AND OBJECTIVES, IS PREPARED. THE ARC STRESSES SELF-ADVOCACY AND COMMUNICATION IN ORDER TO MAXIMIZE INDEPENDENCE. ADAPTIVE TECHNOLOGY IS ALSO USED TO FACILITATE DAILY LEARNING. ADDITIONAL BENEFITS MIGHT INCLUDE SERVICES FROM SPEECH THERAPISTS AND BEHAVORIAL SPECIALISTS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: RESIDENTIAL SERVICES: THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO'S RESIDENTIAL SERVICES ADMINISTERS 10 HOMES SPECIFICALLY DESIGNED TO MEET THE HOUSING NEEDS OF PEOPLE WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES. THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO RESIDENTIAL SERVICES SUPPORTS PEOPLE WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES IN THEIR DESIRE TO LIVE ON THEIR OWN AND BE PART OF THE LOCAL COMMUNITIES. ARC STAFF WORK ONE ON ONE WITH EACH INDIVIDUAL MAINTAINING A CLOSE AND CONTINUING RELATIONSHIP. ARC STAFF PROVIDE DIRECTION AND GUIDANCE BASED ON EACH PERSONS NEED AND IDENTIFIES RESOURCES ESSENTIAL TO IMPROVING THE QUALITY OF ONES LIFE. THIS INCLUDES PAYING THE RENT AND BILLS, COOKING HEALTHY MEALS, AND USING PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION TO WORK, TO THE SUPERMARKET, OR OTHER RECREATIONAL OUTINGS.

For the years ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, no provision for unrelated business taxes is required. The Arc of San Diego believes that they have appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and as such, do not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the consolidated financial statements. The Arc of San Diego is not a private foundation.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section A, Line 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ARC HAS TWO CLASSES OF MEMBERS (EMPLOYEES AND NON-EMPLOYEES). THE MEMBERSHIP SHALL BE OPEN TO ALL PERSONS WHO ARE INTERESTED IN THE PURPOSE OF THE ARC. MEMBERS WHO ARE EMPLOYEES OF THE ARC OR THEIR FAMILIES MAY HAVE VOTING PRIVILEGES EXCEPT THEY MAY NOT VOTE FOR ELECTION OF MEMBERS TO SERVE ON THE BOARD NOR VOTE ON POLICIES RELATING TO SALARIES OR BENEFITS. MEMBERS VOTE ON BYLAW CHANGES APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. NON-EMPLOYEE MEMBERS ARE ALLOWED TO VOTE FOR THE ELECTION OF BOARD MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section A, Line 7a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NON-EMPLOYEE MEMBERS ARE ALLOWED TO VOTE FOR ELECTION OF MEMBERS TO SERVE ON THE BOARD. EACH NON-EMPLOYEE MEMBER IN GOOD STANDING SHALL VOTE FOR NOT MORE THAN 12 OF THE NOMINEES. EACH CHAPTER ADVISORY BOARD SHALL SELECT ONE MEMBER AS THEIR REPRESENTATIVE ON THE ARC BOARD AS A LIAISON BETWEEN THE TWO BOARDS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section A, Line 7b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ANY BYLAW AMENDMENTS REQUIRE A MAJORITY VOTE PRIOR TO A MEMBERSHIP VOTE. CHAPTER ADVISORY BOARDS MUST APPROVE, BY MAJORITY VOTE ANY AMENDMENTS TO ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 14.01 OF THE ARC BYLAWS PRIOR TO THE VOTE BY MEMBERSHIP, WITH EACH CHAPTER ADVISORY BOARD HAVING ONE VOTE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: WORKPAPERS ARE PREPARED BY ACCOUNTING MANAGER AND STAFF ACCOUNTANT & REVIEWED BY THE CFO. THE TAX ACCOUNTANTS PREPARE DRAFT FORM 990. THE DRAFT FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE CFO, ACCOUNTING MANAGER & CEO. A FINAL FORM 990 IS REVIEWED & APPROVED BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE. THE AUDIT COMMITTEE APPROVED FORM 990 IS REVIEWED & ACCEPTED BY THE BOARD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND OFFICERS ARE COVERED UNDER THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY. THE LEVEL AT WHICH DETERMINATIONS OF WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS ARE ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS. ALL POSSIBLE CONFLICTS ARE REVIEWED. PERSONS WITH A CONFLICT WOULD NOT BE PERMITTED TO VOTE OR ACT ON A RELATED TOPIC THAT WOULD GIVE RISE TO A CONFLICT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Compensation and benefits consultants are retained by the Arc of San Diego to provide a compensation and benefits study for its CEO, Officers, and Key Employee Positions. Salary survey analysis includes using published survey date, identifying comparable competitive organizations and presenting them with a custom salary and benefits survey to complete. Additionally, salary data from form 990 is obtained from organizations that do not complete the custom survey. The consultant presents their report to the Executive Compensation Committee and then to the Board of Directors, at which time the compensation for the CEO, other officers and key employee positions is discussed and approved. The approval process is documented.IN SPRING 2020 A COMPENSATION & BENEFITS CONSULTANT WAS RETAINED BY THE ARC OF SAN DIEGO TO PROVIDE A COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS STUDY FOR ITS CEO, OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEE POSITIONS. In February 2021 the consultant provided a completed survey to the Board and CEO
